title: Head-radius bound under tape embedding
statement: Let $\Gamma,S$ be types, let $m,k$ be natural numbers, and let $x$ be an input word over $\Gamma$. Let $\iota$ embed the $m$ tape indices into the $k$ tape indices, let $M$ be a machine with $m$ work tapes, and choose contents and head positions for the additional tapes and an output prefix. For a starting configuration $a$, time bound $t$, and nonnegative integer $B$, suppose that at every time $u\le t$ each work-tape head of $M$ is within distance $B$ of its initial position. Then, starting from the configuration formed by embedding $a$ with the chosen additional tapes and prefix, every work-tape head of the embedded machine remains within distance $B$ of its initial position at every time $u\le t$.
